summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint FormatJS configuration but ships a hostile install-time dropper. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"; setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as _0x488df8/_0x52943e, per-function string/method indirection tables) and performs platform detection (parses /etc/os-release, checks ldd for Alpine/musl), then downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the bun binary executable (mode 493 / 0755), and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using the obfuscator.io string-array rotator pattern (large mixed-type constant array, rotator function, character-decoding routine, hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents are opaque and unrelated to ESLint or FormatJS. The alternate-runtime dispatch causes the obfuscated payload to execute under a freshly fetched non-Node interpreter during `npm install`, bypassing Node-resolved static analysis. An ESLint config package has no legitimate need for an alternate JS runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated math/init payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
